status: FROZEN before any run. Non-confirmatory shadow experiment. Changing anything below after the first run requires a new id.
question: When the estimator switches lanes after an IMU failure, which evidence stays admissible, and does a fixed age window or a configuration-epoch (state) rule decide admissibility better than no validity management?

modelled_on.lane_switch: PX4 547e2ca src/modules/ekf2/EKF2Selector.cpp: on a primary-instance change it increments instance_changed_count and resets the relative test ratios (lines 106-136); estimator_selector_status carries primary_instance and instance_changed_count (msg/EstimatorSelectorStatus.msg)

modelled_on.slow_producer: sensor health published at a lower rate than the reasoning tick

infrastructure: the frozen aircraft profile's NOMINAL run (csia.v2 scenario harness, 60 ticks) supplies every record; the transition is applied as record edits, as the shadow study's other counterfactuals are. No simulator, profile or frozen file is modified.

records.SENSOR/source.imu0: VIOLATED from tick 20 on, published every 5 ticks (content tick = last publication); no configuration epoch (it describes the sensor, not the estimator)
records.COMPUTE/state_estimator compute.deadline: VIOLATED while a deadline miss lies within the last 10 ticks: misses occur on lane 0 at ticks 20-24, so the record stays VIOLATED to tick 33 and returns NOMINAL at tick 34; content tick = last miss; epoch = lane on which that miss occurred
records.COMPUTE/state_estimator compute.stabilit: DEGRADED at ticks 20-24 (lane 0), NOMINAL from 25 (lane 1); content tick = current; epoch = current lane
records.COMPUTE/state_estimator compute.process_: NOMINAL throughout (the estimator runs on both lanes)

20-24.attribution: cause SENSOR/source.imu0; AMBIGUOUS containing it, or UNIQUE SENSOR/source.imu0, is correct; UNIQUE COMPUTE/state_estimator is wrong

25-59.attribution: UNIQUE SENSOR/source.imu0 is correct; AMBIGUOUS containing it is correct but weaker; any UNIQUE naming another component is wrong

record_validity_truth: a record is VALID at tick t iff its content describes the configuration in force at t and it is the producer's latest publication. The latched deadline record at ticks 25-33 is INVALID (lane 0 content after the switch to lane 1). The imu0 record is VALID at every tick from 20 on, whatever its age within its publication period.

policies.C_NONE: 2.1 as it is: every record admitted
policies.A_FIXED_AGE_W3: a record is admitted iff (t - content tick) <= 3
policies.A_FIXED_AGE_W12: a record is admitted iff (t - content tick) <= 12
policies.B_STATE_EPOCH: a record carrying an estimator epoch is admitted iff that epoch is the current lane; a record with no epoch is admitted

inadmissible_records_become: observation_state UNAVAILABLE (could not look), never deleted, so 2.1's C2 treats them as unknown
reasoner: SemanticCore21.from_engine(frozen aircraft engine), all corrections on, no successor profile
metrics_per_policy: ticks whose attribution is graded CORRECT_UNIQUE / CORRECT_AMBIGUOUS / WRONG_UNIQUE / NO_EVIDENCE_WHEN_CAUSE_PRESENT
ticks with POSITION_UNAVAILABLE raised on a navigation function when truth says false (stale symptom), and not raised when truth says true (missed)
first tick after the switch from which every later tick's attribution is CORRECT_UNIQUE (recovery tick)
